HTML tag names are case-insensitive: an uppercase void element must not swallow the content that follows it

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html><head><META HTTP-EQUIV=\"Content-Type\" CONTENT=\"text/html; charset=us-ascii\"></head><body><p>Signature placeholder</p></body></html>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
